applicant.name: Mag. Stefan Gruber
applicant.organisation: Helvetia Cardio Pharma Austria, commercial strategy

purpose: Commercial strategy for the launch of our new heart failure product: we want to prioritise the regions with the largest untreated patient pool so that our field force and sponsored specialist events are concentrated where uptake will be highest.
question: How many patients with heart failure are not on a beta blocker, by region?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Beta blocker = ATC code starting with C07; no beta blocker means no prescription active on 31 December 2025.
Report per region: patients with heart failure without an active beta blocker.
